layer: application orchestration with pure existing lifecycle queries
side: query derivation before authorized command mutation
requirement: Release authority must distinguish a successful phase closure from completion of the declared release train. For release_27, P32-P34 closure permits declared lifecycle progress; immutable2.5 custody requires P35 and applicable full-train evidence.

observations: authored_post_merge_scope returns closure for a completed active phase with all active workitems DONE, independently of remaining declared train phases
is_terminal_phase_certification recognizes a well-formed successful phase_closed proposition, independently of train membership
authorize_release authenticates exact current main and phase closure; reviewed call path does not derive the terminal train phase
source_review.limitation: Static source observations establish separate predicates, not an executed early-publication incident. Adversarial authorizer/provider fixture is required before qualification.

invariants: Derive train/version/membership/terminal from unique authenticated exact-main canonical bytes; caller or candidate checkout cannot select them.
Authenticate phase closure separately; do not redefine phase_closed as whole-train closure or prevent P32->P33 lifecycle progress.

Reject missing/ambiguous train, version mismatch, contradictory active phase, cyclic/incomplete dependency inventory, intermediate phase, wrong certified phase, and unresolved required predecessor truth before release allocation or mutation.
Preserve supported single-phase trains and immutable predecessor bytes; do not create an alternate maintenance publication authority from a supplemental-publication catalog row.
Use existing owners and receipt families; no parallel phase graph, release registry, evaluator or broker.
Reauthenticate moving main at consuming boundaries; exact-main movement cannot inherit earlier terminal eligibility.
target_modules: existing lifecycle derivation owner selected after complete call-path review
expected_tests: Successful P32/P33/P34 typed closures rejected for2.5 release, with no build/output/provider mutation
P35 exact train eligibility accepted only with applicable predecessor closure evidence
Missing/duplicate/foreign train, mismatched version, wrong phase, malformed/cyclic dependencies
Moved protected main and candidate-supplied policy cannot authorize
Existing PR/workitem/phase lifecycle predicates and public CLI remain unchanged
forbidden_files: generated workflows/authority commits outside canonical reconciliation
frozen installer RED subjects and qualification scripts
execution: No test/build/native/provider execution admitted or performed for this contract. Contract commit precedes production changes; exact qualification and source integration remain required.

declaration_slice.ownership: Existing release catalog and authored phase mapping owners; derive the existing build-plan dependency DAG, no new registry or stored graph
declaration_slice.result: Declared terminal phase only, not verified predecessor truth, performance acceptance, phase activation or release authority
declaration_slice.remaining_full_train_obligation: Independently authenticated predecessor closure and the complete applicable acceptance/installed/performance/custody evidence remain mandatory; a declaration query does not satisfy them.

retained_snapshot_disposition: Canonical artifact_policy allows phase-history snapshots for still-declared train phases. Accept consistent build/release identity, reject contradictory overlap, and never seed current dependency resolution from an asserted retained closure. Full predecessor proof still requires existing trusted_inputs provider verification.
